page.overview:
What is Medali?

Medali is a location introduced in Generation IX.

Medali is a city located in Paldea. It has its own Gymnasium, the Medali Gym, where the Gym Leader is Larry, who is also a member of the Elite Four, who specializes in -type Pokémon.
